tactics: intro α l₁ l₂ i h
intro α l₁ l₂ i h <;> split <;> rename_i h' <;> [exact List.getElem_append_left h'; exact List.getElem_append_right (by omega)]
intro α l₁ l₂ i h <;> split <;> simp_all [List.getElem_append_left, List.getElem_append_right]
intro α l₁ l₂ i h <;> by_cases h' : i < l₁.length <;> simp [h', List.getElem_append_left, List.getElem_append_right]
intro α l₁ l₂ i h <;> induction l₁ generalizing i <;> cases i <;> simp_all
